svg.title: Commercial fisher — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as commercial fisher, wearing a raincoat and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A hanging fish with a triangular tail and eye sits apart from a long fishing line ending in an open curved hook. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
